Types

Kitchen sink mixers: pull out and gooseneck

Most kitchen taps sold today are single lever mixers. The choice is between a fixed spout that swivels and a pull out kitchen mixer with a spray head on a hose.

Some people search for a kitchen mixer tap, others for a sink mixer. They are the same product: one lever, one spout, fixed through the sink or the benchtop.

Pricing

Kitchen mixer prices

Three Millennium mixers show their price on this site. The Akemi Sink Mixer is $291.50 to $378.40, the Cioso Sink Mixer is $303.60 to $352 and the Sonix Pullout Sink Mixer is $454.30 to $594, depending on the finish.

The other Millennium and ACL mixers show Enquire Now, and the team confirms the price for the model and finish you choose.

Spouts

Pull out or fixed spout

Pull out or gooseneck kitchen mixer: which suits you?

Pull out mixerGooseneck mixer
SpoutThe spray head pulls out on a hoseA fixed high arc spout that swivels
Good forRinsing a large or double bowl, and filling pots beside the sinkFilling tall pots under the spout
Under the benchNeeds clear space for the hose and its weightNothing extra

The Sonix is described by Millennium as having a single function spray with a magnetic holder that keeps the hose secure.

Finishes

Finishes from chrome to gun metal

The Akemi Sink Mixer is listed in brushed nickel, chrome, gun metal, matt black and modern brass. The Cioso Sink Mixer comes in brushed nickel, gun metal, matt black and modern brass, and the Sonix Pullout in brushed nickel, chrome, gun metal, matt black and modern brass.

Chrome suits a stainless steel sink. Matte black and gun metal sit well with quartz and fireclay sinks.

Availability

Sonix, Cioso and Akemi availability

Send the mixer name and finish, and the team confirms what can be supplied and when. If you are searching for kitchen taps in Sydney to suit a benchtop that is already cut, tell us the tap hole size as well.

Matching

Matching a mixer to your sink

Check the spout reach against the bowl. On a double bowl sink the spout has to swing to both sides. On undermount and double bowl sinks the mixer usually goes through the benchtop, so the hole is drilled in the stone.

Leave room behind the mixer for the lever to tilt back, especially under a window sill.

Ratings

WELS rating and warranty

The Cioso Sink Mixer is listed with a 4 star WELS rating at 7 litres a minute. 8 mixers on this page list a rating in their description. For any other mixer, ask us and we will check the rating with the maker.

ACL lists an 8 year warranty on several of its sink mixers. Ask us for the warranty terms of the mixer you choose.

Getting it

Pick-up and delivery

Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. Call in any time Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. A mixer is easy to collect with your tiles, or it can be delivered across Sydney metro. For sinks and laundry products, see the kitchen range.

Brands

Millennium and ACL mixers

Millennium supplies 30 of the mixers on this page, in its Akemi, Cioso, Jenex and Sonix series. ACL supplies 40, including Otus, Clasico and Hali.

Most of these series are also offered in bathroom tapware, so the kitchen can match the bathroom. See our tapware range.

Care

Cleaning a kitchen mixer

Wipe the mixer with a soft damp cloth and dishwashing liquid, then dry it. Kitchen taps collect grease as well as water marks, so wipe them when you wipe the bench.

Rinse the aerator or spray head now and then. Do not use oven cleaner, bleach or scourers near a coloured finish.

Kitchen mixers

Kitchen mixer questions

What is a pull out kitchen mixer?

It is a sink mixer with a spray head that pulls out of the spout on a flexible hose. You can direct the water around the sink, and the head docks back into the spout when you let go.

What height kitchen mixer do I need?

High enough to fit your tallest pot under the spout, and low enough to clear any shelf or window sill behind the sink. Measure both before you choose.

Are black kitchen mixers hard to keep clean?

Matte black shows water marks and grease more than chrome or brushed nickel. Wiping it dry after use keeps it looking even. Avoid abrasive cloths, which polish the matte surface.

How much is a kitchen sink mixer?

The kitchen sink mixers with a price on this site run from $291.50 to $594, depending on the model and finish. Other mixers show Enquire Now.

Do kitchen mixers fit any sink?

Most fit a single tap hole of about 35 mm in the sink or benchtop. Check the tap hole size and the spout reach against your sink before you buy.

What is a gooseneck kitchen mixer?

It is a mixer with a tall, curved spout shaped like a goose's neck. The height makes it easy to fill large pots, and the spout swivels across the sink.
